items.title: UN says AI safeguards can’t wait for certainty
items.summary: Governments need to rein in increasingly capable AI agents before their risks are fully understood, a United Nations scientific panel warned in the global organization's first major assessment of OpenAI's hack of Hugging Face earlier this year. The report cements AI's place on the global diplomatic agenda this week as leaders gather in New York […]

items.title: Amazon blocks Meta’s Muse AI agent
items.summary: Meta's Muse AI agent has been blocked from shopping Amazon on behalf of its users, GeekWire reports.
